cohort: 50,487 deliveries recorded in the Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Center (KCMC) medical birth registry between 2000-2015
finding: Higher risk of perinatal death was associated with low maternal education level, rural residence, <4 ANC visits, postpartum hemorrhage, placental abruption, low birth weight delivery, male infant sex, and being referred for delivery.
mod_finding: Deliveries by cesarean section had a lower risk of perinatal death compared to vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with perinatal death
